chat.personal_plane.personal_plane.bind_: §cYou can only bind the entry point inside a personal dimension
chat.personal_plane.personal_plane.no_bu: §cYou don't have permission to build in this dimension
chat.personal_plane.personal_plane.no_in: §cYou don't have permission to interact in this dimension
chat.personal_plane.personal_plane.no_ma: §cYou don't have permission to manage this personal dimension
chat.personal_plane.personal_plane.recar: §cFloor recarpet is on cooldown, please try again later
chat.personal_plane.personal_plane.cmd.p: §cThis command can only be used by players
chat.personal_plane.personal_plane.cmd.d: §aWorld files are kept on disk; recreating the dimension loads the original terrain.
gui.personal_plane.pdim.road_enabled.des: When enabled, platform areas are wrapped by a ring of road; otherwise the whole floor is pure platform.
gui.personal_plane.pdim.road_chunks.desc: Side length of the platform area enclosed by each road ring (chunks, 1 - 14).
gui.personal_plane.pdim.floor_count.desc: Number of floor layers, %d blocks apart; lowering it and rebuilding clears untouched old layers.
gui.personal_plane.pdim.apply_layout.tip: Save the layout and rebuild all generated chunks
gui.personal_plane.pdim.layout_note: New settings apply to newly generated chunks at once.
gui.personal_plane.pdim.layout_note2: Layers are %d blocks apart; Apply Layout rebuilds generated chunks.
gui.personal_plane.pdim.layout_custom_pr: A custom preset is in use; road settings have no effect.
gui.personal_plane.pdim.disable_mob_spaw: Allow mobs to spawn naturally inside the dimension.
gui.personal_plane.pdim.lock_weather.des: Freeze the current weather; it will no longer change.
gui.personal_plane.pdim.lock_time.desc: Freeze the time of day at the value set by the time slider.
gui.personal_plane.pdim.daylight_cycle.d: Let day and night alternate inside the dimension.
gui.personal_plane.pdim.time_locked_hint: Enable Lock Time to use this slider
gui.personal_plane.pdim.apply_recolor.ti: Rebuild all generated floor blocks with these colors
gui.personal_plane.pdim.no_inertia.desc: Stop drifting instantly when you release the move keys while flying.
gui.personal_plane.pdim.time_value.desc: Time used while time is locked (0 = 06:00, 6000 = 12:00, 18000 = 00:00).
gui.personal_plane.pdim.movement_speed.d: Walk and fly speed inside the dimension (5% - 200%).
gui.personal_plane.pdim.create.note: Floor colors only. Other rules can be set later.
gui.personal_plane.pdim.create.tip: Create the dimension with this floor style
chat.personal_plane.no_access: §cYou no longer have access to this team dimension
gui.personal_plane.pdim.mode.tip:
Current mode: %s
Applies on your next entry; the current screen still manages this dimension.
gui.personal_plane.pdim.mode.team_requir: Join an FTB team to share a dimension
gui.personal_plane.pdim.mode.ftb_missing: Install FTB Teams to share a team dimension
personal_plane.configuration.presetPath: Floor preset id or JSON path
personal_plane.configuration.defaultDime: Default dimension mode for new players
personal_plane.configuration.allowAllyEn: Allow allies to enter team dimensions
personal_plane.configuration.allyCanBuil: Allow allies to build/interact in team dimensions
